title.es: Convergencia funcional sustancial hacia el perímetro Acosta Matos
title.en: Substantial functional convergence into the Acosta Matos perimeter

meaning: reappearance or accumulation of representation, administration, title, voting, creditor, access and project capacities
adoption, reliance or ratification of earlier Community machinery
possible continuity of knowledge through identified people, offices, files and vehicles
excluded_meaning: automatic transfer of knowledge, intent or liability

registry.rule: Every graph node resolves to exactly one immutable registry ID.

reading_rule: Arrow direction is the reader's evidence-flow order, not automatic legal causation, command or transfer of mens rea.

stages.label_es: 3 · Concentración de crédito, título, voto y acceso
stages.label_en: 3 · Concentration of credit, title, voting and access

stages.label_es: 4 · Control, proyecto, inversión y operación posteriores
stages.label_en: 4 · Later control, project, investment and operation

strongest_current_inference.es: Múltiples puentes independientes y fechados —incluido DP 3205/2014 como punto medio de títulos comunitarios disputados— conectan el perímetro demandante, comunitario, jurídico y administrativo de 2009–2011 con la posterior concentración CAM/Acosta Matos de crédito, fincas, voto, seguridad/acceso, control material y proyecto. La fuerza está en la convergencia acumulada y en varios puentes directos, no en una transferencia automática de culpa o dolo.
strongest_current_inference.en: Multiple independent, dated bridges—including DP 3205/2014 as a midpoint involving disputed Community titles—connect the 2009–2011 claimant, Community, legal and administrative perimeter with the later CAM/Acosta Matos concentration of credit, units, voting, security/access, material control and project roles. The force lies in accumulated convergence and several direct bridges—not in automatic transfer of guilt or intent.
